budget_guidance.solve_side_per_config: one full engine walk-forward run (~2.56s) per (a,tau,s,n_min,cap) config; beta refits inside the run (train-only) at no extra step
budget_guidance.prediction_layer_per_config: ONE shared pure-v6 base run (~2.19s, amortized), then ~0.02s per (b,tau,variant) overlay config
budget_guidance.per_policy_overhead: one SpecPlan build per (policy,W) (~0.08s worst observed), reusable across every config of that policy
budget_guidance.note: walk-forward era-transfer protocol (laws #2) multiplies solve-side cost by the number of fit/validate splits; prediction-layer overlays reuse one base run per split.
